name: Strong Back
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Equip abilities you activate that target enchanted creature cost {3} less to activate.
Aura spells you cast that target enchanted creature cost {3} less to cast.
Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 for each Aura and Equipment attached to it.
blocked_sentences: Equip abilities you activate that target enchanted creature cost {3} less to activate.
Aura spells you cast that target enchanted creature cost {3} less to cast.
Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 for each Aura and Equipment attached to it.

needs.what: A battlefield static that discounts the activation cost of activated abilities printed on OTHER permanents, filtered by who activates them and by what the ability is attached/aimed at -- the mirror of `spell_cost_reduction`, but for activated abilities instead of spells
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `spell_cost_reduction` is the only cost-lowering static in `static_effects`, and `player_statics.spell_cost_reduction` is called from `cost_reduction`/`costs` with a CardDef being cast, so it prices spells only. The one reduction that touches an activated ability is `mana_reduction` in `cost_keys`, and `schema.CostModel.mana_reduction` says it is applied by `costs.ability_mana` for 'this cost node' -- it lives inside the ability's own `cost`, so only the card printing the equip ability could discount it, never a different permanent's Aura.

needs.what: A marker on a compiled ability saying it is an *equip* ability, so a static's filter can name 'equip abilities' as a class
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cards/authoring/templates.py` compiles 'Equip {2}' into an ordinary activated ability whose cost is mana and whose effect is `attach` -- nothing distinguishes it from any other activated ability that attaches something. `loader/vocabulary.py` states this outright beside `activate_loyalty_as_though_instant`: 'Leonin Shikari's "you may activate equip abilities any time you could cast an instant" wants this seam pointed at equip, and nothing on `Ability` marks an equip ability yet.' Without the marker the discount could not be limited to equip.

needs.what: A cost-reduction filter clause that asks what the spell or ability being priced is TARGETING -- here, 'that target enchanted creature', i.e. a target equal to the object the discounting Aura is attached to
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `SPELL_FILTER_KEYS` (the `affects_spells` vocabulary) is deliberately the printed face plus `controller`, and its own comment says so: board state a card in hand does not have is excluded. It is matched by `characteristics._matches_printed`, which is handed a CardDef with no chosen targets, because legality prices the spell before it is on the stack. So `{"subtypes": ["Aura"], "controller": "you"}` would discount EVERY Aura you cast, not only the ones aimed at the enchanted creature -- a softening, not the printed card. `COST_REDUCTION_REFUSED_FILTER_KEYS` further refuses `attached` in a reduction filter, so the enchanted creature cannot even be named there.

needs.what: A static magnitude that counts the Auras and Equipment attached to the permanent the static affects, and scales it (x2 per attachment). Two halves: a static filter key for 'permanents attached to <that object>', and an arithmetic leaf in the static value language so a count can be multiplied
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `static_filter_keys`'s `attached` points the other way -- `characteristics._matches` implements it as `obj.oid == source.attached_to`, i.e. it selects the enchanted creature itself, so a `{"count": {"attached": true, "subtypes": [...]}}` asks how many permanents ARE the enchanted creature (0 or 1), not how many hang off it; there is no `attached_to` key in the static filter list. And `STATIC_VALUE_KEYS` is `const`, `count`, `mana_symbols`, `counters_on`, `permanents_entered_this_turn` plus the per-player life/count leaves -- no `times`, `sum` or `half` (those are effect-side `value_keys` only, and `characteristics._static_value` raises DslError on an unknown leaf), so even a correct count could not become +2/+2 per attachment. Separately, 'Aura and Equipment' is an or-of-subtypes and static `subtypes` is a conjunction, with no `any_subtypes` beside `any_types`.
